name: LinkPay Ultra
summary: Enterprise plan at $299/month. 1% transaction fee (min $0), free deposits, free decline fees. 3% cashback capped at $299/month (equals subscription cost). 100 free cards/month. 50 team members.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only, no physical card

faq.question: Does the LinkPay Ultra charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes. It charges US$299 per month. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the LinkPay Ultra?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
